name: SAP UI5 MCP server
description: Gives coding agents UI5 API docs, best-practice guidelines, linting, manifest validation, and app scaffolding for SAP UI5 developers, as a local npm MCP server.

skills.name: UI5 App Scaffolding
skills.description: Scaffolds new UI5 applications from a set of templates, and new UI Integration Cards.

skills.name: UI5 API Reference
skills.description: Fetches and formats UI5 API documentation and retrieves UI5 framework version information.

skills.name: UI5 Guidelines
skills.description: Provides UI5 and Integration Cards best practices, plus guidelines for converting JavaScript apps and controls to TypeScript.

skills.name: UI5 Linting and Manifest Validation
skills.description: Runs @ui5/linter to report UI5-specific code issues and validates manifests against the UI5 Manifest schema.

skills.name: Project Info
skills.description: Extracts metadata and configuration from a UI5 project.
